terra.problem: “That fast” attributes a speed to Caleb’s action that the text does not give.
The text does not say that no money changed hands or that Caleb made no payment. It says he drove the descendants out.
The text does not say that nobody signed anything. It does not mention a treaty.
“Close on the family feel” does not make sense for the answer “servant,” and calling Acsah the prize is an unkind way to describe her.
The sentence breaks awkwardly after the quotation: “in marriage.” to whoever captures Kiriath-sepher.
“Her visit” adds a visit the passage does not describe.
“Yes and then some” suggests Caleb gave Acsah more than she requested. The text does not say that.
“Didn't go the way it was planned” adds a plan that the passage does not state.
The text says the Jebusites remained, but it does not say nobody made peace.
